about_the_game:
You wake up on a mysterious island after a shipwreck. No shelter, no food… and a group of survivors counting on you. Can you turn a pile of wood and stones into a thriving civilization?

🛠 BUILD AND EXPAND
Construct houses, warehouses, hospitals, and more. Every building matters, and every upgrade could mean the difference between life and death.

🌾 MANAGE YOUR POPULATION
Each survivor has a unique role—hunters, farmers, doctors, and even jokers (yes, humor keeps morale up!). Assign tasks wisely to survive.

🌍 SURVIVE NATURE’S WRATH
Storms, droughts, and other disasters will challenge your settlement. Do you have what it takes to endure?

🦌 HUNT, FARM, FISH
Food won’t magically appear! Hunt wild animals, grow your own crops, and fish in the island’s waters to keep your people fed.

🧠 UPGRADE AND EVOLVE
Unlock skills, improve buildings, and specialize your people to maximize production and withstand threats.

🏕 EVERY DECISION MATTERS
If your population drops to one… GAME OVER! Survival isn’t just about strength—it’s about strategy.

Do you have what it takes to turn a group of castaways into a legendary civilization?

🔹 Survive. Build. Conquer. 🔹

short_description: Survive, build, and conquer in Survivors of the Wildstone! After being shipwrecked on a mysterious island, lead a group of survivors! Manage, expand, and evolve to forge a civilization from scratch in this challenging building and strategy game!
